properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: docs/yarn.lock is the lockfile of the repo's SvelteKit docs site, which installs every published @web3-onboard/* wallet package (see docs/package.json). hash.js@1.1.7 is a transitive dep of that closure (classic JS crypto used by ethers-era tooling) and ships SHA-1/SHA-2 implementations into the docs bundle. Presence in the shipped dependency closure is the inventory fact; no direct call site in docs first-party code, and reachability through installed wallet packages cannot be ruled out from so

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js@3.3.0 is the legacy crypto-js major, pulled transitively by a wallet SDK inside the docs site's @web3-onboard/* closure (docs/yarn.lock pins ^3.1.9-1 → 3.3.0). The MD5 implementation is available to any code in that closure. Note the repo's own packages/passport separately pins crypto-js ^4.2.0 and calls CryptoJS.AES — reported separately. Changeable by bumping the wallet packages that pull crypto-js 3.x.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-1 as provided by crypto-js@3.3.0, the legacy crypto-js major in the docs site's dependency closure (docs/yarn.lock). Available to any installed wallet package at runtime; no first-party call site in docs code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 ECDSA is the Ethereum keypair curve — Shor-vulnerable, the most migration-relevant asset in my shard. Provided by @noble/curves@1.0.0, locked in docs/yarn.lock as a transitive dep of the viem/@web3-onboard/passport-era stack the docs site installs to document it. Every wallet in the closure signs with this curve; the docs site ships the implementation into visitors' browsers. Changeable only by moving the wallet SDK stack (viem/@noble) to PQ hybrids — the curve is fixed by the Ethereum

Presence-only; no first-party Ed25519 call site in this repo. Migration to ML-DSA is a vendor/library matter.
